主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. released its financial report for February 2014, reporting consolidated net income of $3.8 billion and funds from operations of $3.4 billion. The report was filed with the SEC as a Form 6-K on February 14, 2014. The filing includes an exhibit list with Exhibit 99.1 detailing the financial results and Exhibit 99.2 as a letter to shareholders. The report was signed by B. D. Lawson, who holds the title of Managing Partner & CFO. The filing is incorporated by reference into Brookfield Asset Management Inc.'s registration statement on Form F-9 (File No. 333-112049).
